.saturating_sub(self.fixtures_skipped_feature);\n        if denom == 0 {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n        100.0 * self.fixtures_matched as f64 / denom as f64\n    }\n\n    pub fn .saturating_sub(self.fixtures_skipped_feature);\n        if denom == 0 {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n        100.0 * self.fixtures_matched as f64 / denom as f64\n    }\n\n    pub fn Differential comparator: compares decoded `Field`s against golden references.\n//!\n//! Metadata fields are compared exactly; grid values are compared within the\n//! per-field tolerance derived from the packing header (half-ULP of the\n//! quantization step — see MetaMismatch(Vec<MetaMismatch>),\n    MaskMismatch { index: usize },\n    ValuesMismatch(Vec<PointMismatch>),\n    LengthMismatch { expected: usize, actual: usize },\n}\n\nimpl FieldResult {\n    pub fn is_match(&self) -> bool {\n        matches!(self, FieldResult::Match)\n    }\n}\n\n// ── Coverage report ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Per-(GDT,PDT,DRT) triple statistics.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]\npub struct TemplateStat {\n    pub attempts: u32,\n    pub matched: u32,\n}\n\n/// Aggregated outcome over all fixtures and fields in the agreement percentage.\n    pub fixtures_skipped_feature: usize,\n    /// Fixtures skipped due to storage=remote not being fetched locally.\n    /// These are NOT counted in fixtures_total and excluded (no golden) - (skipped due to missing features)\n        let denom = self.fixtures_total\n            .saturating_sub(self.fixtures_no_golden)\n            .saturating_sub(self.fixtures_skipped_feature);\n        if denom == 0 {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n        100.0 * self.fixtures_matched as f64 / denom as f64\n    }\n\n    pub fn self.fixtures_total\n            .saturating_sub(self.fixtures_no_golden)\n            .saturating_sub(self.fixtures_skipped_feature);\n        println!(\"=== Differential Harness Coverage ===\");\n        println!(\n            \"Fixtures : {} total  ({} comparable, {} no-golden, {} skipped-feature, {} skipped-remote-not-fetched)\",\n            self.fixtures_total,\n            comparable,\n            self.fixtures_no_golden,\n            self.fixtures_skipped_feature,\n            self.fixtures_skipped_remote\n        );\n        println!(\"  matched      : {}\", self.fixtures_matched);\n .saturating_sub(self.fixtures_skipped_feature);\n        if denom == 0 {\n            return 0.0;\n        }\n        100.0 * self.fixtures_matched as f64 / denom as f64\n    }\n\n    pub fn
